question: ________ is an example of acoelomate.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Platyhelminthes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Platyhelminthes** are commonly known as **flatworms**.
 
• They are characterized by their **simple, flattened, and unsegmented body structure**.
 
• Platyhelminthes are acoelomates, meaning they lack a body cavity (coelom) between the digestive tract and outer body wall.
 
• This phylum includes organisms such as **tapeworms and flukes**, which can be free-living or parasitic.
 
• Unlike other phyla, Platyhelminthes have a three-layered body plan but no specialized circulatory or respiratory systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Acoelomates** are animals that do not possess a coelom, which is a fluid-filled cavity lined with mesoderm tissue.
 
• The lack of a coelom in Platyhelminthes limits their size and the complexity of their organ systems.
 
• They exhibit bilateral symmetry and have a simple gut with a single opening.
 
• Platyhelminthes play a significant role in medical and biological research due to their regenerative abilities and parasitic nature.
